changeAwareDecision.reasonForRun: Workstream 08 changed the canonical manifest/runtime for the first independently accepted V2 art batch. This is a coherent catalog milestone, so the full 16-collection matrix was appropriate rather than relying on the previous unchanged-hash proof.
changeAwareDecision.futurePolicy: For later small canonical batches, test changed collection(s) plus one stable control at 1408/1024/390/320 and reserve another full 16-collection sweep for a coherent milestone or final gate.

scope.browser: Playwright 1.55 Chromium headless on GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04
scope.build: Vite 8.3.0 production build; 1613 modules; CSS 167.39 kB / 35.69 kB gzip; JS 304.31 kB / 93.39 kB gzip

changedCollectionEvidence.companions: 12 visible cards at all four reduced-motion viewports; all 12 image-backed cards loaded, had alternative semantics, explicit width/height, readable state, focus-visible behavior and keyboard activation; phone grids were 2 columns at 390px and 320px.
changedCollectionEvidence.stableControlTops: 12 visible cards at all four reduced-motion viewports with the same loading, intrinsic-dimension, focus, keyboard, readability and phone-grid checks passing.

contrast.reason: Catalog text is composited over gradients/images/translucent layers, so the existing solid-background sampler cannot produce defensible ratios. Screenshot/device-aware contrast remains a final manual/tool-assisted gate.

screenshotsAndArtifacts.coverage: All 16 canonical collections retained at desktop 1408x1056 and phone 390x844; tablet 1024x768 and phone 320x568 were measured by the same strict gate.

deterministicReferenceCapture.note: The capture/diff workflow is prepared, but the original user reference image files are not repository-accessible. Generated promotional collages must not be used as substitutes.

limitations: This PASS is headless Chromium browser-emulation evidence, not physical iPhone/iPad/Android performance evidence.
VoiceOver/TalkBack/NVDA remain NOT TESTED; browser semantics, focusability, labels, keyboard activation and reachability were verified.
Exact rendered color contrast remains NOT TESTED because the existing automated sampler cannot resolve layered visual backgrounds defensibly.
The catalog gate remains unapproved because only 4/192 current hashes are canonically accepted and final release QA is separate.
nextAction: After the next small Workstream-08 canonical integration, test only changed collection(s) plus a stable control at 1408/1024/390/320 with normal and reduced-motion evidence. Run the next full 16-collection sweep only at a coherent catalog milestone or final gate. Continue deterministic Home/Store/Quest capture support; final pixel-diff requires the original reference files to be made repository-accessible.
